steps.text: One thing I did notice is that within the application, the healthcheck endpoint is called far more often than in other environments. When I look at the network tab, I see it being called perhaps every 5 minutes, versus when the application is deployed in the streamlit cloud, I never see it called in the network tab (I am on Chrome)

Interestingly, there is also a very good chance I am getting a timeout. Just got this error while running a long running process, which caused the application to refresh. It tried to call the stcore/health endpoint. Potentially, if I have a long running process, perhaps this causes a timeout, which refreshes the application?
